rules.title: Prohibition on sale or use of coordinated pricing algorithms for residential dwelling units
rules.requirement: Berkeley Municipal Code chapter 13.63 prohibits selling, licensing, or otherwise providing coordinated pricing algorithms to Berkeley landlords for setting or recommending rents or occupancy levels for residential dwelling units in Berkeley, and prohibits landlords from using such algorithms for those purposes. rules.title: Statewide rent cap for most residential real property
rules.requirement: California caps rent increases for covered residential units at no more than 5% plus the applicable cost-of-living change, or 10%, whichever is lower, over any 12-month period, measured from the lowest gross rental rate charged during the prior 12 months. For the same tenant, rent may not be increased in more than two increments in a 12-month period; initial rent for a new tenancy is not capped, and local stricter rent control continues to govern where applicable.

rules.title: California security deposit cap for residential tenancies
rules.requirement: For residential property used as the tenant’s dwelling, a landlord generally may not demand or receive security exceeding one month’s rent, plus first month’s rent paid on or before initial occupancy. A small-landlord exception allows up to two months’ rent if the landlord is a natural person or qualifying LLC and owns no more than two residential rental properties with no more than four total dwelling units; this exception does not apply to service members.

rules.requirement: Santa Ana prohibits selling, licensing, or otherwise providing an algorithmic device to a landlord, and prohibits landlords from using an algorithmic device to set rental rates or occupancy levels for residential rental property in the city. Tenants may sue for injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties up to $1,000 per violation, with each month and each residential rental property constituting a separate violation for landlord use.
rules.key_value: Up to $1,000 per violation; each month and each residential rental property is a separate violation for landlord use

coverage_conditions.text: Applies to residential rental property in Santa Ana, including dwellings or units intended for human habitation and units in a mobile home park.
coverage_conditions.quote:
"Residential Rental Property" means any dwelling or unit that is intended for
human habitation, including any dwelling or unit in a mobile home park.

exemptions.value: software exception
exemptions.text: Excluded software that publishes reports from aggregated historical nonpublic competitor data more than 90 days old or public information and does not recommend future rental rates or occupancy levels.
exemptions.quote:
Algorithmic Device does not include either of the following:
1) A software or product used by a Person to publish reports regarding
rental rates or occupancy levels from aggregated historical Nonpublic
Competitor Data that is more than 90 days old, or from information available to
the general public, and does not recommend rental rates or occupancy levels
for future Residential Rental Property Leases or renewals.

exemptions.text: Excluded software used to establish rental rates or income limits under affordable housing program guidelines.
exemptions.quote:
2) A software or product used by a Person to establish rental rates or
income limits in accordance with local, state, or federal affordable housing
program guidelines.

rules.penalty: A Tenant may seek injunctive relief, damages, or civil penalties of up to $1,000 per violation; a prevailing Tenant shall recover costs and reasonable attorney's fees.
rules.rule_quote:
(b) It is unlawful for a Landlord to use an Algorithmic Device to set rental rates or
occupancy levels for Residential Real Property.
rules.interaction_text:
(b) The remedies under Section 8-3703 are cumulative and are in addition to any
other remedies in this Article or at law, statute, or ordinance.
